newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco de Galicia started.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said on Wednesday analyst Andrew Collins had started coverage of Argentina's Banco de Galicia with a rating of buy.
-- "Banco de Galicia appears to be fairly valued when compared with the Merval and the sector," Collins wrote in a March 18 report.
-- "However, we maintain that the shares deserve to trade at a premium given the bank's superior growth prospects."
-- He set a 15-month price target of $30.20 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR).
-- The company's ADRs closed on Wednesday up 1/4 at 24-1/4.
